correctness.rationale: Nonnegative relations yield a complete n-by-n Apéry rectangle; exact residue thresholds have one or two height-n jumps and are otherwise decreasing. Each jump produces n disjoint gap-block starts and all boundaries are exhausted. The Apéry sum and max prove genus and Frobenius formulas; membership differences prove coefficient-support formula. An independent dynamic-programming checker inspected every integer through F+1 for 79 cases n=2..80, confirming the full finite predictions; infinite proof is algebraic, not empirical.

value.rationale: The three generators are the canonical integer geometric triple from consecutive coprime factors. Frobenius/genus formulas locate only extremal or aggregate gaps, while the new result classifies EVERY maximal gap start and all semigroup-polynomial negative and nonzero coefficient locations uniformly, an exact arithmetic structure usable to locate boundary transitions without enumeration. This is a meaningful infinite-family classification and not merely a restatement of the known Frobenius formula.
